title: Cutoff identity from the radial first-variation identity along γ = φ(·/τ), for a general measure (parent Steps 7–10)
statement: Let n, ℓ ∈ ℕ, E := Ambient n ℓ = ℝ^{n+ℓ} with its Borel σ-algebra, μ a measure on E that is finite on compact sets, U ⊆ E any set, h, q : E → ℝ, g, H : E → E, φ : ℝ → ℝ of class C¹, ξ ∈ E and c, τ, R, A ∈ ℝ. Write r = r(x) := |x − ξ|, B := B_R(ξ) = closedBall ξ R (closed ball), φ' := deriv φ, γ(t) := φ(t/τ), γ' := deriv γ and G(x) := ⟨x − ξ, g(x) + h(x)H(x)⟩. Assume: (i) tsupport h ∩ B ⊆ U; (ii) g(x) = 0 for every x ∉ tsupport h; (iii) h and q are a.e. strongly measurable with respect to μ restricted to B; (iv) |h(x)| ≤ A and |q(x)| ≤ 1 for every x ∈ B; (v) x ↦ ⟨x − ξ, g(x)⟩ and G are μ-integrable on B; (vi) φ(t) = 0 for every t ≥ c; (vii) τ > 0 and cτ ≤ R; (viii) (RFV_τ) ∫_U [h(x)(n·φ(r/τ) + r·γ'(r)·(1 − q(x))) + φ(r/τ)⟨x − ξ, g(x)⟩] dμ(x) = −∫_U h(x)φ(r/τ)⟨x − ξ, H(x)⟩ dμ(x), where ∫_U is the Bochner integral with respect to μ restricted to U. Then n·∫_E h(x)φ(r/τ) dμ + ∫_E h(x)(1 − q(x))·((r/τ)φ'(r/τ)) dμ + ∫_E φ(r/τ)G(x) dμ = 0 (Bochner integrals over E).
